NoSQLServer v0.77 validation
Date: 2026-08-23
Runtime: Open Object Rexx 5.3.0 r13196, 64-bit debug build
House dependency: Alchemy Objects v0.4.4
Crypto dependency: oorexx_crypto_v0.1
Unicode dependency: TUTOR 0.7 only when explicitly enabled

New acceptance
--------------
  tests/v077_alchemy_object_base_smoke.rex                      PASS

The v0.77 smoke proves:
  - File/Object/JSON/SQLite/GeoPackage/Federated engines inherit AlchemyObject
  - runtime, SQL executor, transaction and Database Core adapter inherit it
  - service objects receive Alchemy identity/lifecycle evidence
  - registered NoSQL method contracts match the live service surface
  - configured sealer/authority propagates to created service objects
  - federated child engines inherit the house base
  - public sealed snapshot carries NoSQL package version and service role
  - house compliance is NOT falsely claimed merely because the base is used
  - SQL executor's ordinary version() method remains operational
  - capability ALCHEMY_OBJECT_BASE_0_4_4 is advertised

Historical/versioned regression
--------------------------------
The existing versioned suite was exercised across the candidate lineage. The
argument-style v02-v07/v051 gates pass when supplied their required database
root argument. v061_torture_harness_smoke.rex remains an obsolete pre-FK
assertion and is not a current correctness gate. The live GeoPackage smoke is an
external-dataset probe; the packaged GeoPackage fixture tests pass.

Compilation
-----------
  shipped .cls/.rex targets: 95
  rexxc failures:             0

Architecture boundary
---------------------
Only stateful service/facade/transaction objects are migrated in v0.77. Rows,
relational values, predicate nodes, geometry values and parser/value objects
remain lightweight and do not acquire Alchemy telemetry/security overhead.
Existing callers do not need to supply a sealer or authority.
